columns.n_candidates: int, candidate pairs for a MODIS detection (0 for VIIRS rows)
columns.other_sensor_distance_m: m, pair distance if matched, else nearest other-sensor detection in the time window
columns.other_sensor_pass_evidence: bool, the other sensor detected any fire nearby at that time
columns.cell_fire_days_prior_12m: float, fire-days in the same 0.1 deg cell over the previous 12 months (all sensors)
